How the session runs
Stage Minutes What
happens
Set-up about 2 Hello, a microphone and camera
check. Not scored.
Part 1 4–5 Short questions on one familiar topic.
Part 2 3–4 A task card, one minute to make
notes, then 1–2 minutes of speaking.
Part 3 5–6 A discussion linked to the Part 2 topic:
opinions, comparisons, reasons.
Wrap-up 1–2 Next steps. Bands are ﬁnalised after
the session, never while the learner is
still speaking.
One live session of 15–20 minutes on Google Meet with Mr. Jay, camera on, timed like the IELTS Speaking test.
The learner sits Form A or Form B; the other form is kept for the re-test. For learners under 18, a parent or
guardian books and gives consent, and the session is never recorded.

REPORT
·
FICTIONAL
STUDENT
Student Minh (ﬁctional), age 10
Booked by Parent, with consent
Form A (Form B is kept for the re-test)
Recording None (under 18: never recorded; live notes only)
Assessor Mr. Jay, Jurassic English
Bands
Criterion Band In
one
line
Fluency and Coherence 5.0 Keeps going in Part 1; stops after
about 50 seconds in Part 2.
Lexical Resource 4.5 Knows everyday words; repeats "very
good" and "very fun".
Grammatical Range and Accuracy 4.5 Simple sentences are mostly right; the
past tense slips in stories.
Pronunciation 5.0 Easy to understand; word endings (-
ed, -s) are often dropped.
Overall 4.5 Average 4.75, rounded down to the
nearest half band.
What
Minh
does
well
Answers
straight
away. In Part 1 Minh answered every question without long pauses. Asked "What do you
do after school?", Minh said: "I play badminton with my brother, and then I do my homework."
Gives
a
reason
when
asked. "I like weekends because I can sleep late."
Is
easy
to
understand. Clear rhythm and good volume; Minh did not need to repeat anything.
What
holds
the
band
back
1. The
past
tense
in
stories. Part 2 card: "Describe a day out with your family." Minh started in the past and
then slipped into the present: "Last summer we go to the beach. My father buy ice cream." Four slips in 50
seconds.
2. Part
2
is
short. Minh stopped at about 50 seconds and said "That's all." The test allows up to 2 minutes; a
full answer is about 90 seconds or more.
3. Word
endings. The -ed ending and the -s on he/she/it verbs are often not heard: "my mom cook", "we walk
to the park" (meaning walked).
4. Repeated
words. "Very good" and "very fun" came up six times. Minh needs two or three new ways to
describe a good time.

Target
Target
band: 5.0 overall.
Target
date: 12 weeks from this Baseline, then a re-test on Form B.
Why
this
target: the two lowest bands (4.5) are about habits, not missing knowledge. Minh knows the past
forms when asked one by one, so regular practice can make them automatic.
Plan
Built on the weakest criterion: Grammatical Range and Accuracy.
Weeks Focus What
Minh
practises
1–3 Stay in the past Tell a short story every day and keep
every verb in the past until "Now…".
Say 10 past verbs aloud, holding the
last sound.
4–6 Speak for longer Build Part 2 one step at a time: who-
what-when, then one thing someone
said, then before and after. Target 90
seconds.
7–9 New words for good times Replace "very good" and "very fun"
with word pairs such as "had a great
time" and "it was so exciting".
10–12 Put it together Full Part 2 and Part 3 answers under
exam timing. Re-test on Form B.

Family plan for Minh
SAMPLE
·
FICTIONAL
STUDENT
Three
things
to
do
at
home
Ten minutes a day is enough.
1. Dinner-table
story. Ask Minh, "What happened at school today?" Let Minh answer in English for one
minute. Listen for one thing only: did the verbs stay in the past?
2. The
"why"
question. After any answer, ask "Why?" once. A reason makes an answer longer and stronger.
3. Hear
the
ending. When Minh says a past verb, ask Minh to say it again "with the end you can hear":
walked, played, needed.
What
not
to
do
Don't correct every mistake. One kind of mistake a week is enough.
Don't ask Minh to learn answers by heart. Examiners notice memorised answers.
What
happens
next
Lessons can follow this plan: 1-to-1 with Mr. Jay, or Mr. Jay can recommend self-study lessons for each
step.
The re-test uses Form B, so Minh meets new questions, not the same ones.
Tóm
tắt
cho
phụ
huynh
Minh nói tự tin và dễ hiểu. Điều cần cải thiện nhất là giữ thì quá khứ khi kể chuyện và nói dài hơn ở Part 2.
Mục tiêu: band 5.0 sau 12 tuần, sau đó kiểm tra lại bằng đề B. Mỗi ngày phụ huynh chỉ cần 10 phút: hỏi con kể
lại một chuyện trong ngày bằng tiếng Anh và hỏi thêm "Why?".
